notes: THE DEFECT, stated as a scale error rather than as a weight. recal_101's line is `PD2 = max(PD2, _dmeas101)`. The left side is a RANK IN A BAND: 0.55 + 0.45 x Pvot(composite) x vote_factor, spanning cards 55 to 99. The right side is an ABSOLUTE LEVEL: recal_86's line centred on 58, regressed by recal_92's reliability curve, whose whole full-sample population spans 43 to 81 with p50 57.7 and p99 72.8. Comparing them with max() means the measurement can only be heard when it beats the card's band position on a scale that is 15 points narrower — so in the entire 2014+ pool it fired for ONE card, Wembanyama '26. Amen Thompson '26 reads 65 on the tracked line against 92 in the band. The measurement was not being underweighted; it was being read in the wrong units.

THE FIX, in one sentence: the band ranks a composite, so give the composite the measurement. `PD` gains TRK_BAND_W x sample_weight x q, where q ramps over the top quartile of the measured pool, and the SAME frozen Pvot function is asked again. Two properties fall out for free rather than being arranged. (1) The Pvot POOL is bit-identical, because the term is applied to the card's own lookup inside the loop and never written back to `tmp` — recal_114 stated this doctrine for exactly this reason, and it means no card rises by another card falling past it. (2) At wv = 0 the recomputed expression is `(1-0)*novote + 0*(...)`, i.e. PD2 term for term, so every no-vote card is flat BY CONSTRUCTION and not by tuning. Jaylen Brown '26, Stephon Castle '26, Ajay Mitchell '26, Kevin Durant, Stephen Curry and Ayo Dosunmu do not move by a point.

BOTH CONSTANTS ARE MEASURED. TRK_BAND_W = 0.32 is the distance from a season's median voted composite to its maximum, over all thirteen tracked seasons: 2014 0.361, 2015 0.353, 2016 0.327, 2017 0.288, 2018 0.310, 2019 0.317, 2020 0.264, 2021 0.301, 2022 0.330, 2023 0.322, 2024 0.330, 2025 0.294, 2026 0.350 — mean 0.319, median 0.322. So the statement the constant makes is exact: a fully elite measured season is worth enough to carry the MEDIAN voted defender of that season to the top of his own band, and not one point more. TRK_BAND_LO / TRK_BAND_TOP = 62.5 / 72.8 are the p75 and p99 of the regressed tracked reading over the 1,068 full-sample tracked cards (p50 57.7, p90 66.5, p95 68.6, max 80.7).

THE FIRST CUT WAS MEASURED AND REJECTED, which is what chose the ramp. Opening it at recal_86's neutral 58.0 instead of the p75 moved 320 cards instead of 210 and broke recal_100's Thunder '26 anchor (dial 86 -> 92), because a merely-average tracked season buys real band position where the voted composite pool is dense: Luguentz Dort '26 at -0.2% gained five points and OG Anunoby '23 eight. His word is ELITE, the top quartile is what elite means on this file's own distribution, and at 62.5 Dort '26 gains one point and Anunoby '23 one.

THE FOOTPRINT: 210 perdef cards move, ALL 210 UP (the term is one-way by construction), max +16, and the distribution is 69 at +1, 58 at +2 or +3, 27 at +4, and 38 at +5 or more. rimprot moves on ZERO cards and o_ovr on ZERO. Downstream: d_ovr 176 movers (all up, max +9), ovr 120 (all up, max +5). The perdef 99 block goes from 11 cards to 18 — the additions are Draymond '21/'22/'23, Tony Allen '13/'14, Marcus Smart '20 and Paul George '14, every one of them a first-team All-Defensive season with a tracked sheet to match, but it IS compression at the summit and recal_84/recal_90 exist because of compression at the summit.

WHY THE CLASS THAT RISES IS MOSTLY BIG AND MOSTLY TALL, and it is the same finding recal_101 recorded rather than a new one. The cards that gain most are the ones whose composite is emptied by height while their measurement is strong — Giannis '19/'20, Anthony Davis '15-'23, Bam Adebayo '20-'22, Al Horford '22, Gobert '21/'22, Joakim Noah '15. The composite charges height twice (rep_hf and height_inv) and the measurement charges it not at all, so reading the measurement is, in effect, a partial refund of a double charge that recal_101 measured, named and left standing. That is a real and arguable side effect, it is reported here rather than smoothed over, and the clean fix for it is the height ruling recal_101 asked for, not this term.

THE ORDER TEST THAT MATTERS MOST is Amen '26 above Jaylen Brown '26 on perdef, 98 to 66, on a WORSE diff and a SMALLER sample. That is only defensible because the separating evidence is the All-Defensive vote, and because the round pays the measurement strictly INSIDE the voted band rather than on a channel a no-vote card can reach. State it plainly: this round makes the vote worth more, not less — it lets an elite measurement decide WHERE in the voted band a certified defender sits, and gives an uncertified one nothing at all.
